aiGuidance.purpose: Public word: side. looks_like is what leaning on it looks like in plain third-person English; shadow (public word: overdone) is how it goes wrong when nothing balances it. Contained by exactly one tension.
aiGuidance.extraction: Title is the side's short name; copy no first-person or mystical source wording.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Both sides of a tension stay named and legitimate.
